verdict.rationale: The only SDK evidence is a single marketing line on the Instant Pay page claiming 'TypeScript and Python SDKs' (jeeves-docs-17). A documented REST API with mTLS/OAuth 2.0 auth and specific endpoints provides an underlying surface to build against (jeeves-docs-7, jeeves-docs-8, jeeves-docs-10). However, no SDK reference docs, package names, repositories or install instructions appear, and probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI spec all returned 404 (jeeves-probe-2). Missing for 10: SDK documentation or reference pages, package/repo links and install instructions, confirmation the SDKs cover the full API platform rather than only Instant Pay, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
